name: Panther
source:
The executive of the Red Flower Society.
He used to be a burlesque dancer for the show club NASA, but after the death of Boss Ting, he has decided to rebuild the club as the new owner.
He was once arrested as a suspect in the murder of his girlfriend Yanyan and was defended by Francis.
He had been a celibate bachelor and had been involved with a number of women, but he later married Paulownia and had a child.
He is currently working hard to "create a place where minorities are not excluded.
